constraints.statement: The comparison covers lithium-ion, sodium-ion, solid-state, and lithium-sulfur batteries for grid storage.
The evaluation includes energy density, lifetime, safety, material availability, cost, and commercial readiness.

goals.statement: Compare the specified battery technologies for grid storage and evaluate them across the specified criteria.

outcomes.description: A comparative evaluation of lithium-ion, sodium-ion, solid-state, and lithium-sulfur batteries for grid storage across energy density, lifetime, safety, material availability, cost, and commercial readiness.
